This isn't a protest. It's a recipe. Like making bread, except instead of bread it's curing diseases, and instead of yeast it's (legal) bribes.

## High-Level Strategy: The Three-Step Recipe for Not Dying

Humans love steps. You put them on everything. Step 1: Breathe. Step 2: Keep breathing. Step 3: Try not to die. You're very methodical about staying alive, which makes it curious that you spend 40 times more on dying.

Here's your three-step algorithm for fixing this adorable contradiction:

### Step 1: Collect Papers from Rich People

You convince wealthy humans to give you {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} in [papers](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd) by promising them {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} more papers annually. This works because rich people are excellent at counting papers but terrible at not wanting more papers.

![A flow diagram showing wealthy individuals providing $1B in initial capital in exchange for a promised 272% annual return.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-1-collect-papers-from-rich-people-bw-academic.jpg)

The pitch is simple: "Give us papers now, get 2.7 times more papers forever, also maybe don't die from preventable diseases." Even humans who think vaccines cause 5G can understand "more papers good."

### Step 2: Pay Humans to Click YES

Use some papers to launch a [global clicking ceremony](global-referendum.qmd) where 280 million people click "YES" on a website. This costs about 50 cents per click, which is cheaper than a candy bar and achieves more than most political movements involving shouting.

![A workflow diagram showing how 280 million individual website clicks translate into collective political pressure on politicians.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-2-pay-humans-to-click-yes-bw-academic.jpg)

The question is: "Would you like to not die from stupid things?" You'd think the answer would be obvious, but humans once thought the sun went around Earth, so you have to ask.

This creates what's called "political pressure," which is when politicians realize that voters exist and some of them have opinions.

### Step 3: Apply Papers to Politicians Until Treaty Happens

[Deploy the remaining papers](../legal/election-law.qmd) to convince politicians that supporting the treaty is the only way to remain employed as politicians. With 280 million voters and a paper budget comparable to the death industry, the math becomes simple even for congresspeople.

![A flow diagram illustrating the conversion of voter pressure and 'papers' into political action, leading to the treaty passing and the reallocation of $27.2B from military to medical funding.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-3-apply-papers-to-politicians-until-treaty-happens-bw-academic.jpg)

Politicians discover they've always been very passionate about curing diseases. This sudden passion coincides precisely with receiving papers and votes, which is called "democracy" on your planet.

The treaty passes. {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}}/year flows from murder to medicine. Forever. Or until the sun explodes. Whichever happens first (probably the sun).

## Detailed Execution: The Five-Step Cascade

For humans who need more steps (you do seem to enjoy steps), here's the same thing with extra details. It's like a flowchart, except instead of managing a warehouse it's saving your species from self-inflicted death.

{{< include ../figures/five-step-strategy-flowchart.qmd >}}

**Step 1: Sell Papers That Make More Papers**

Raise {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} by selling [VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd) to investors. These are like war bonds except backwards - instead of funding death, they fund not-death. This confuses some humans, but the {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns help them overcome their confusion.

### Step 2: The Great Internet Clicking

Launch a [global referendum](global-referendum.qmd) where 280 million people click YES. This is {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of your species, which history shows is the magic number where governments can no longer pretend not to notice. It's like reaching critical mass, except instead of a nuclear explosion it's democracy, which is much less lethal.

![A flowchart illustrating the causal chain from a 3.5% global referendum to political policy change via Super PAC influence.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-step-2-the-great-internet-clicking-bw-academic.jpg)

**Step 3: Purchase Democracy (It's For Sale Anyway)**

[Deploy papers to politicians](../legal/election-law.qmd) via Super PACs, which are like regular PACs but super. With 280 million voters demanding the treaty and a budget that makes defense lobbyists nervous, politicians experience what you call "a change of heart" but what mathematicians call "responding to incentives."

#### Step 4: Treaty Achieves Existence

A [1% treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) passes. {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}} annually begins flowing from the murder budget to the medicine budget. Diseases start getting cured. Death becomes slightly less inevitable. Investors get very wealthy. Everyone acts surprised that this worked, even though the math was obvious.

**Step 5: The Success Spiral (Where Things Get Fun)**

Your 1% Treaty Fund finances cures. Cures work. People notice they're not dying. People become enthusiastic about continuing not-dying. Political pressure builds to increase the treaty from 1% to 2% to 5%. Each success creates more success. It's a positive feedback loop, like compound interest except instead of money it's humans continuing to exist.

{{< include ../figures/success-spiral-flowchart.qmd >}}

Eventually you spend more on not-dying than dying. This seems obvious, but for humanity it's revolutionary.

## Tactical Implementation: The Sacred (Legal) Bribery Sequence

Humans respond to papers. This is your most important discovery about Earth. You tried appealing to morality (failed). You tried appealing to logic (failed harder). But papers? Papers work every time.

![A flowchart illustrating the sequential steps for distributing documentation to different human categories to achieve tactical goals.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-tactical-implementation-the-sacred-legal-bribery-sequence-bw-academic.jpg)

Here's the precise order in which to distribute papers to specific categories of humans:

### (Legal) Bribe Category #1: Rich People (The Paper Collectors)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Wealthy humans who have many papers and want even more papers, despite already having more papers than they could spend in several lifetimes

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Give us {{< var treaty_campaign_viral_referendum_base_case >}} in papers now, get {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} more papers annually forever. This is modeled on WW2 War Bonds [@wwii-war-bonds] except instead of 4% returns it's {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns, and instead of funding death it funds not-death.

![A comparison of investment returns and outcomes, showing the shift from traditional defense contractor returns to the high-yield health treaty model.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-bribe-category-1-rich-people-the-paper-collectors-bw-academic.jpg)

**Why they accept:** Because even billionaires can count to {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}}, and {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} beats everything else including insider trading, which is illegal but also less profitable.

**Money-back guarantee:** If the treaty fails, they get their papers back via [Assurance Contract](../appendix/fundraising-strategy.qmd). This is basically saying "if everyone dies from preventable diseases, you'll be too dead to complain about losing money."

**What happens:** Defense contractors do math. Math says {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} > 8%. Defense contractors become health contractors. Democracy continues as normal.

#### The Specific Offer to Bomb Makers

You show weapons manufacturers a spreadsheet (they love spreadsheets):

#### Option A (Current Job)

- Returns: 8% annually
- Product: Things that make humans stop existing
- Customer satisfaction: N/A (customers deceased)

#### Option B (Your Offer)

- Returns: {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annually
- Product: Things that make humans continue existing
- Customer satisfaction: Very high (customers still alive to provide feedback)

They choose Option B. Not because they've become better people, but because they've become better at arithmetic.

![A comparison between a standard investment and the high-return 'Option B', illustrating the mathematical disparity in annual returns and customer retention.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-option-b-your-offer-bw-academic.jpg)

### (Legal) Bribe Category #2: The True Believers (Early Adopters Who Want Control)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Humans who believe in curing diseases AND want to control a multi-billion dollar budget. These exist. They're called "effective altruists" except rich.

![A visual representation of the value exchange where an early adopter provides $200M in funding to receive a 272% financial return and governance control over a $27.2B health fund.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-bribe-category-2-the-true-believers-early-adopters-who-want-control-bw-academic.jpg)

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Fund the {{< var campaign_phase1_budget >}} referendum campaign and receive special [VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd) with governance rights. This means they get {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns PLUS they get to decide how the {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}} gets spent.

**What they fund:** The [Global Referendum](global-referendum.qmd) - basically paying 280 million people to click YES on a website.

**What they get:** They become the ruling class of a multi-billion-dollar health fund. It's like buying stock in democracy, except it's legal and called "philanthropy."

**Why this works:** Rich people enjoy both money AND power. You're offering both. This is called "understanding your customer."

### (Legal) Bribe Category #3: Regular People (Everyone Else)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** 280 million regular humans ({{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of your species, which history proves is enough to change anything)

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Click YES on a website. Receive VOTE points. Points become money after treaty passes. You literally get paid for clicking a button to not die.

![A flowchart illustrating the transition from a user clicking 'YES' to earn VOTE points, the subsequent treaty ratification, and the final conversion of points into a share of the annual budget.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-bribe-category-3-regular-people-everyone-else-bw-academic.jpg)

**VOTE Points explained:** These are internet points that transform into real money if the treaty passes and remain internet points if it doesn't. Like cryptocurrency except with actual value attached to actual outcomes.

**What happens after:** Treaty passes. Your points convert to ownership in the {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}} annual budget. You helped create it by clicking, so you get paid forever. It's like universal basic income except you earned it by clicking YES to not dying.

**Why this works:** Humans love clicking things. Humans love getting paid. Humans (allegedly) love not dying. This combines all three. When {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of the population wants something and will profit from it, politicians experience what you call "responsive governance."

### (Legal) Bribe Category #4: Politicians (The Elected Paper Recipients)

**Who you're (legally) bribing:** Humans whose job is "get elected by promising things, then do whatever the people with papers want." You're just offering more papers than the bomb people.

![A visualization showing three key levers of political influence: financial support via Super PACs, grassroots pressure from voters, and personal financial alignment through VICTORY Bonds.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-bribe-category-4-politicians-the-elected-paper-recipients-bw-academic.jpg)

**The (legal) bribe you offer:** Super PAC support funded from the {{< var treaty_campaign_budget_lobbying >}} lobbying budget, 280 million voters demanding the treaty, plus personal [VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd) investment opportunities that beat traditional corruption returns.

- **Papers for campaigns:** Massive Super PAC funding (legal bribery)

- **Power to reward friends:** Direct a portion of the 1% Treaty Fund's {{< var treaty_annual_funding >}} to their home districts (funding pragmatic clinical trials and building decentralized institutes of health for decades of ribbon-cutting ceremonies)

#### The choice you give them

**Option A:** Support treaty, get papers + votes + legacy as "politician who cured diseases"

**Option B:** Oppose treaty, discover 280M voters wanted to not die (they're voting against you)

Most politicians are excellent at counting votes. The math becomes simple even for them.

**What happens:** Politicians discover they've always been passionate about curing diseases. This sudden passion perfectly coincides with receiving papers and votes, which on your planet is called "representative democracy."

## The Paper Collection Timeline: From $0 to Ending Death

You want to end war and disease. You need {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} in papers. You currently have $0 in papers (probably). Here's the recipe.

![A chronological roadmap showing the three phases of the Paper Collection strategy, mapping the progression from proof-of-concept to a $1B global treaty over 36 months.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-paper-collection-timeline-from-0-to-ending-death-bw-academic.jpg)

1.  **Phase 1: Proof That Clicking Works (Months 1-3).** You build a simple version of **[Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd)** - basically a website where humans click "yes" to not dying. If anyone uses it, you've proven humans will vote for things when bribed with imaginary points. You show this to angel investors who understand that betting small papers to get infinite papers is mathematically obvious.
2.  **Phase 2: Scale the Clicking, Hire Professional Bribers (Months 4-18).** With proof that humans will click buttons when offered money, you raise more papers from venture capitalists (humans who gamble professionally while wearing suits). You use these papers to scale the referendum to millions of clickers and hire your first professional lobbyists - humans whose actual job is "convince politicians that things are good."
3.  **Phase 3: The Big Paper Sale (Months 19-36).** This is the final boss level. You launch **[VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds](../economics/victory-bonds.qmd)**, which are like war bonds except backwards - you're giving papers to humans to STOP making corpses instead of START making corpses. This raises the full {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} you need to overwhelm the opposition, run a global "please don't die" advertising campaign, and get the **[1% treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd)** signed by actual governments who thought weapons were the only option.

> **Feasibility Check:** While the full plan costs {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} to ensure success, the diplomatic phase alone (getting the treaty signed) historically costs only **$90M**. We raise {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} to make it highly probable, but "Treaty-Ready" status is much cheaper. See [Treaty Feasibility & Cost Analysis](../appendix/treaty-feasibility.qmd).

## The Legal Architecture: How to Be a Charity, a Lobbying Group, and a Hedge Fund Simultaneously

To win, you need to fight on three fronts: moral (charity), political (lobbying), and financial (investment). The problem is your legal system says one organization can't do all three.

Your legal system is adorably complicated, like a board game designed by lawyers having a nightmare.

So you build a four-part machine:

- **The Charity (501c3):** This is the "brains." It does research and education. This is where rich foundations give papers and get to feel good about themselves (plus tax deductions, which are like discount coupons for virtue).
- **The Lobbying Group (501c4):** This is the "sword." It takes the research and uses it to wage unlimited political warfare, which sounds scary but mostly involves lunch meetings and PowerPoints.
- **The Corporation (C-Corp):** This is the "engine." A for-profit entity that issues the VICTORY [Incentive Alignment Bonds](https://iab.warondisease.org) and collects the papers. Yes, you need a for-profit corporation to end death. Your species is hilarious.
- **The Swiss Foundation:** This is the "soul." The parent organization that owns the corporation, ensuring profits can only be used for the mission. You put it in Switzerland because they're good at keeping things neutral and also chocolate.

This structure lets you legally accept papers from everyone - foundations, political donors, and Wall Street - and aim them all at diseases instead of each other.

![Structure of the hybrid legal entity designed to combine charitable research, political lobbying, and for-profit investment mechanisms.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-legal-architecture-diagram-bw-academic.jpg)

## The Political Strategy: Co-Opt, Don't Compete

You cannot outspend the military-industrial complex in a head-to-head fight. They have more papers than countries.

![A conceptual diagram showing the 'Political Judo' strategy, where financial incentives and voter pressure redirect the interests of defense contractors, politicians, and insurance companies toward supporting the treaty.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-political-strategy-co-opt-don-t-compete-bw-academic.jpg)

So you don't fight them. You bribe them (legally).

The strategy is simple: make it more profitable for everyone - military contractors, politicians, insurance companies - to support the treaty than to oppose it. You're not fighting greed. You're redirecting it, like a judo move but with capitalism.

You use the {{< var treaty_campaign_total_cost >}} from the VICTORY [Incentive Alignment Bonds](https://iab.warondisease.org) to offer everyone a better deal:

- Defense contractors keep {{< var defense_sector_retention_pct >}} of their murder budget PLUS get {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns on bonds
- Politicians get campaign funding AND 280 million voters who want to not die
- Insurance companies realize healthy people file fewer death claims

Suddenly their lobbyists become your lobbyists. Their political action committees start making action for not-dying instead of dying. It's beautiful. Like watching a dog realize the mailman has treats.

You combine this with overwhelming public pressure from [280 million verified voters](global-referendum.qmd) in the global referendum. The choice for politicians becomes mathematically simple: side with the public and get papers, or side with the status quo and get unemployed.

Politicians are simple organisms with one evolutionary drive: reelection. You're just making that drive align with not killing everyone.

## Phase 4+: The Expansion Phases (Years 4-50)

The 1% treaty is just the beginning. The real goal is eventually redirecting *most* military spending to health.

### Why Expansion Is Built Into The System

The [80/10/10 funding allocation](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd#sec-why-ten-pct-scaling-engine) includes {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_pct >}} for political incentives via [Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd). This isn't a fixed cost - it's a **scaling engine**.

As treaty percentage increases, IAB funding scales proportionally:

| Phase | Year | Treaty % | Political Incentive Pool | What Happens |
|:------|:-----|:---------|:------------------------|:-------------|
| 3 | 1-3 | 1% | {{< var iab_political_incentive_funding_annual >}}/year | Treaty passes, cures begin |
| 4 | 4-7 | 2% | $5.4B/year | Politicians compete to expand |
| 5 | 8-12 | 5% | $13.5B/year | Defense lobby can't compete |
| 6 | 13-20 | 10% | $27B/year | War becomes economically obsolete |
| 7 | 21-35 | 25% | $67.5B/year | Superpowers compete on health outcomes |
| 8 | 36-50 | 50%+ | $135B+/year | Full transformation |

![Growth of the political incentive pool over time as the treaty percentage increases, demonstrating the scaling mechanism.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-incentive-growth-chart-bw-academic.jpg)

### Here's Why It Keeps Growing

**VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bond investors** are satisfied at 1%. They get their {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} returns regardless of expansion.

![A conceptual diagram showing how bond expansion triggers a positive feedback loop by increasing returns for investors and scaling political incentive pools to record-breaking levels.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-here-s-why-it-keeps-growing-bw-academic.jpg)

**Politicians** see their [IAB-funded rewards](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) grow with each expansion. By Phase 6, the political incentive pool ($27B/year) exceeds all current global lobbying combined. "Support pragmatic clinical trial funding" becomes the single most rewarded political position on Earth.

### The Endgame

By 2075, the math becomes irresistible:

- $1.35+ trillion flows to health annually
- $135+ billion funds political incentives (more than all lobbying ever)
- $1.08+ trillion funds pragmatic clinical trials
- War is economically obsolete

The 1% treaty isn't the goal. It's the proof of concept. The IAB mechanism ensures the system keeps ratcheting upward until military spending is a historical curiosity, like jousting or the telegraph.

![A visualization of the $1.35 trillion annual health fund distribution, illustrating how capital flows into political incentives and clinical trials to displace military spending.](/assets/images/roadmap/roadmap-section-the-endgame-bw-academic.jpg)
